name: Abiel
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bechorath, the son of Aphiah, a Benjamite, a mighty man of power.
At Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, and his sons are named down to the line of Ner, Kish, and Saul.
The chapter returns to Gibeon and repeats the line of Ner, Kish, and Saul, tracing Saul's sons and the house of Jonathan down through Micah to Azel.
